reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Danfoss Link
reconfigure.description: Pair again with a new code, or enter other credentials for the same CC.

menu_options.pair: Pair with the code from the CC

pair.title: Pair with Danfoss Link CC
pair.description: On the CC start pairing of a new app; the display shows a pairing code. The code is valid only for a short time, enter it right away.

data_description.device_name: Home Assistant appears under this name in the CC's list of paired apps.

verify.title: Connection failed
verify.description: Pairing succeeded, but the first connection to the CC failed. Submit to try again (no new code needed).

credentials.title: Use an existing identity
credentials.description: Paste the contents of danfoss_identity.json (from tools/danfoss_cli.py), or the certificate, private key and CC peer id of a paired app.

error.invalid_code: That is not a pairing code. Enter it exactly as the CC shows it.
error.lan_code: Codes starting with 0000 are for pairing on the local network, which is not supported. Use pairing through the Danfoss cloud.
error.code_expired: No CC is waiting for this code. It expired or was mistyped; start pairing on the CC again.
error.wrong_code: The CC rejected the code. Check it and try again, or start pairing on the CC again.
error.pairing_timeout: The CC stopped answering during pairing. Check that it is online and try again with a new code.
error.pairing_failed: Pairing failed, see the log for details.
error.invalid_credentials: The identity could not be read, or the private key does not belong to the certificate.
error.cc_offline: The Danfoss cloud cannot reach your CC. Check that the CC is connected to the internet.
error.cannot_connect: Cannot connect through the Danfoss cloud (mdg-danfoss.hosted.trifork.com). If another client uses the same identity, close it.

abort.already_configured: This Danfoss Link CC is already configured.
abort.wrong_cc: These credentials belong to a different CC.

data_description.scan_interval: How often the CC is read. Every poll goes through the Danfoss cloud.

end_before_start.message: The vacation must end after it starts.

end_in_past.message: The vacation must end in the future.

choose_config_entry.message: You have more than one Danfoss Link CC; choose which one.

not_loaded.message: The Danfoss Link CC is not loaded.

set_schedule.name: Set schedule
set_schedule.description: Set the comfort (at home) periods of a room for the selected days. The rest of each day uses the eco temperature. Rooms in the living zone share one schedule.

periods.name: Comfort periods
periods.description: List of HH:MM-HH:MM intervals in 15 minute steps, e.g. ["06:00-08:00", "16:00-22:30"]. Empty list = eco all day.

plan_vacation.name: Plan vacation
plan_vacation.description: Plan a vacation like the app's vacation calendar: the CC switches to vacation mode at the start and back to the schedule at the end.

config_entry_id.name: CC
config_entry_id.description: Only needed when you have more than one Danfoss Link CC.

cancel_vacation.name: Cancel vacation
cancel_vacation.description: Remove a planned vacation or end a running one.

config_entry_id.description: Only needed when you have more than one Danfoss Link CC.
